Terms of use and contribution terms

The Lango App puts Lango heritage, language and clan records in your pocket: discover your heritage, register your clan, contribute cultural and natural observations, learn Leb Lango and connect with the global Lango community.

The Lango are a Nilotic people of north-central Uganda. Oral tradition remembers a long migration from the north, a society built on clans rather than kings, a colonial era that created chiefs where there had been none, and a post-independence history in which Lango sons and daughters stood at the centre of the nation.

This is a dictionary-based translator, not a full machine-translation model. It looks for the whole sentence among the worked examples of the Practical Lango Grammar, then matches the longest phrases in the dictionary, and finally translates word by word. Leb Lango grammar is rich, so ask a fluent speaker to check longer sentences.
